⌈

Syntax

uint8 FrIf_CtrlIdx,
Fr_ChannelType FrIf_ChnlIdx
)
Service ID [hex]
0x18
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant
FrIf_CtrlIdx
Index of the FlexRay CC to address.
Parameters (in)
FrIf_ChnlIdx
Index of the FlexRay Channel to address in scope of the FlexRay
controller FrIf_CtrlIdx.
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
▽
△
Return value
Std_ReturnType
E_OK: The call of the FlexRay Transceiver Driver’s API service
has returned E_OK.
E_NOT_OK: The call of the FlexRay Transceiver Driver’s API
service has returned E_NOT_OK.
Description
Wraps the FlexRay Transceiver Driver API function FrTrcv_ClearTransceiverWakeup(). The
enum value "FR_CHANNEL_AB" shall not be used.
Available via
FrIf.h
⌋
